title: Idol Solo 013 · 콜로설(인도 미인) · 포다이트 · 3/4 서기

Background & Lighting: A bright pale warm-sand stylized background, a single strong warm light from one side, deep soft shadows in every crease and beneath every hanging roll, the polished colour bands gleaming, glossy anime highlights on every curve.
